description: This file defines utility functions for translating JIT schema functions into native C++ API representations in the PyTorch codebase. It handles type conversions, argument handling, function naming, and return type specifications for native functions, facilitating the generation of consistent C++ API wrappers.

methods.name: str name(func: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Generates a function name string from a FunctionSchema, appending '_out' and overload name if applicable.

methods.name: NamedCType argumenttype_type( t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName, symint: bool )
methods.description: Converts a schema type to a NamedCType for native API, handling tensors, scalars, and optional types.

methods.name: CType returns_type(rs: Sequence[Return], *, symint: bool)
methods.description: Determines the return type CType for a given sequence of Return objects, considering symmetry annotations.

methods.name: NamedCType argument_type(a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName, symint: bool)
methods.description: Maps an Argument object to its corresponding NamedCType, considering mutability and type.

methods.name: list[Binding] argument( a: Argument | SelfArgument | TensorOptionsArguments, *, is_out: bool, symint: bool, )
methods.description: Generates a list of Bindings for a given argument or argument-like object, handling defaults and specialization for TensorOptions.

methods.name: list[Binding] arguments(func: FunctionSchema, *, symint: bool)
methods.description: Collects and processes all arguments (including out and non-out arguments) for a FunctionSchema, returning their bindings.

ctags.name: argument
ctags.signature: ( a: Argument | SelfArgument | TensorOptionsArguments, *, is_out: bool, symint: bool, )

ctags.name: argument_type
ctags.pattern: /^def argument_type(a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName, symint: bool) -> NamedCType:$/

ctags.name: argumenttype_type
ctags.signature: ( t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName, symint: bool )
